offering_description.value: Operates route-based video gaming terminals placed in bars, restaurants and truck stops, sold to location owners and players through revenue-sharing placement agreements. It owns, installs, maintains and runs the terminals under state gaming licenses.

primary_services.value: terminal route operations; terminal servicing and maintenance; location management

customer_segment.value: B2B: bars, taverns, restaurants and truck stop operators hosting gaming terminals

end_markets.value: gaming and entertainment; hospitality; food and beverage

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: share of net terminal income from gaming terminals placed at host locations

value_chain_position.value: service provider: operates and services gaming terminals, takes in net terminal income and pays host locations a share; asset operator: owns and runs a fleet of gaming terminals placed at third-party venues

specialization.value: niche specialist: single line: route-operated video gaming terminals

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: placement agreements with bars, restaurants and truck stops

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state gaming licenses for terminal operation, regulated by Illinois Gaming Board and Montana gaming authorities

notes: Geographic footprint and terminal counts by state may have changed; verify current states served.
